label: bpe_mlemma+mstruct-LEARN-CAUSAL_bpe_17k
reason: The causal shift was applied only to root-family blocks, so mstruct — equally a per-word form feature, and 92% within-word leak on its own — was left unshifted. The run was reported as a causal measurement and was not one. Fixed by shifting every per-word fact with shared word boundaries (CAUSAL_SEMANTICS = 2).

label: bpe_mprefix+mstruct-LEARN-CAUSAL_bpe_17k
reason: Causal runs whose word boundaries were INFERRED from the codes rather than read from the tokenizer. Two defects: v1 shifted only root-family blocks, leaving mstruct leaking; v2 shifted everything but inferred boundaries, which collapse when the reference fact varies within a word (mprefix). A v2 checkpoint is also unreproducible — the boundary rule lives in the forward pass, so re-scoring it under v3 code evaluates it under boundaries it never trained with. Requires CAUSAL_SEMANTICS >= 3.
